# 17 Close the board: full end-to-end verification and final demo

## Outcome

Every line of spec.md's acceptance criteria is proven through `render()` on real source text, the
demo shows one comprehensive class diagram exercising everything in scope, and the glossary
carries the class-diagram vocabulary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A single `examples/class-full.srn` exercises every in-scope feature at once — classes with
  all member forms, all eight relationship types with labels and multiplicity, annotations,
  generics, a namespace, both note forms, `direction`, an interaction, a style directive, and a
  `timeline:` block — and `render()` mounts it with zero error diagnostics.
- [ ] Each spec.md acceptance-criteria line is covered by a test at the `render()` seam, not only
  at a unit seam. Where a criterion is genuinely only checkable at a unit seam, say which and why.
- [ ] `demos/class-diagram.html` renders that comprehensive example against the real Vite bundle,
  with working Next/Reset controls for its timeline, verified by rasterizing and looking.
- [ ] `CONTEXT.md` gains glossary entries for the class-diagram vocabulary — class, member,
  relationship, namespace, note, author style — following the existing format, and disambiguating
  any term that now means more than one thing across the three diagram kinds.
- [ ] `.dev/mermaid-diagram-roadmap.md` is updated to mark class diagrams done.

## Test seam

`render(source, container, options?): SirenRenderResult` — integration under jsdom, the board's
comprehensive closing test.
